table.retrieve:
SELECT 
	name1, 
	value1=CASE WHEN Value1 > 0 THEN Value1 ELSE 0 END, 
	value2=CASE WHEN Value1 < 0 THEN ABS(Value1) ELSE 0 END, 
	UnpostedBalance = ISNULL(UnpostedBalance, 0),
	AliasName, 
	Category, 
	Area, 
	AreaCode, 
	address,
	phone

FROM

(SELECT 
	A.Name AS name1, 
	Sum(V.Balance) AS value1, 
	Sum(UV.Balance) AS UnpostedBalance, 
	A.AliasName, 
	Category=CC.Name, 
	Area=Area.Name, 
	AreaCode=Area.AreaCode,
	Address=RTRIM(LTRIM(C.Address1)) + ' ' + RTRIM(LTRIM(C.Address2)),
	phone=max(C.phone)
FROM 
	Accounts A
	LEFT OUTER JOIN 
	(SELECT T.AccCode, Sum(T.Debit - T.Credit) AS Balance 
	FROM VirtualGL T 
	WHERE T.Date <= :ar_Date
	GROUP BY T.AccCode) AS V ON (A.AccCode = V.AccCode)
	LEFT OUTER JOIN 
	(SELECT A.AccCode, Balance=SUM(A.Debit - A.Credit) 
	FROM dbo.Fn_GetUnposted_AccTrans() AS A
	GROuP BY A.AccCode) AS UV ON (A.AccCode = UV.AccCode),
	SubAccounts S,
	Customer C,
	CustomerCategory CC,
	Area
WHERE 
	A.SubCode = S.SubAccCode AND 
	S.SubAccCode = 3 AND 
	(A.Restricted = CASE WHEN :ar_restricted = 0 THEN 'N' ELSE 'Y' END OR
	A.Restricted = CASE WHEN :ar_restricted = 0 THEN 'N' ELSE 'N' END) AND
	A.AccCode = C.CustCode AND 
	C.CustCatCode = CC.CustCatCode AND
	C.AreaCode IN (:ar_Areas) AND 
	CC.CustCatCode IN (:ar_CustCat) AND 
	C.AreaCode = Area.AreaCode
GROUP BY 
	A.AccCode, A.Name, A.AliasName, C.Address1, C.Address2, Area.Name, Area.AreaCode, CC.Name) A
ORDER BY 
	Area, Category, NAME1, AliasName
